mapper.select: SELECT * FROM alert_record WHERE rule_id = #{ruleId} AND device_id = #{deviceId} AND status <> 'RECOVERED' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE alert_record SET trigger_count = #{triggerCount}, last_triggered_at = #{lastTriggeredAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, trigger_value = #{triggerValue}, notified_at = #{notifiedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, updated_at = #{lastTriggeredAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} WHERE id = #{id} AND status <> 'RECOVERED'

UPDATE alert_record SET status = 'ACKNOWLEDGED', acknowledged_at = #{acknowledgedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, acknowledged_by = #{acknowledgedBy}, updated_at = #{acknowledgedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'TRIGGERED'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alert_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status <> 'RECOVERED'
SELECT r.* FROM alert_record r LEFT JOIN alert_rule ar ON ar.id = r.rule_id WHERE r.status <> 'RECOVERED' AND (ar.id IS NULL OR ar.deleted = 1) ORDER BY r.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
